_README: Open blockers on a PRODUCTION release. Checked by scripts/check-release-blockers.js.
Run bare, it REPORTS: part of preflight, so every push shows what still blocks a release.
Run with --releasing, it FAILS while any blocker is open: that is the gate, and it belongs in
whatever command actually ships. Preflight is a push gate, not a release gate, and conflating
the two would either deadlock the feature branch or make this advisory. It is neither.

blockers.title: the application retains PostgreSQL superuser privileges for ordinary operations
why_it_blocks: A superuser bypasses GRANT and row-level security, so no in-database privilege separation
is possible. Every control in the PRPA schema is therefore a CHECK or a BEFORE trigger,
which a superuser connection can also DROP. Ruling 18 item 6 asked that only a trusted
scanner workflow be able to set scan verdict fields; what shipped is structural
separation, not privilege separation, and this is the gap.
blockers.design_verified: scripts/check-db-role-separation.js (31 assertions) and scripts/check-startup-without-ddl.js (28 assertions) — both exit 0 on a disposable cluster
remaining_work: CODE: done (ruling 27 item 5). Boot no longer applies any DDL — server.js calls
src/lib/schema-ready.js, which only SELECTs, and exits non-zero if the schema is absent.
Migrations run as their own process: node scripts/migrate.js, 47 steps, with a
schema_migrations ledger. Proved on a disposable cluster by
scripts/check-startup-without-ddl.js (28 assertions, exit 0): the app imports, assesses,
confirms, reviews and exports as a role with NOSUPERUSER, no CREATE on schema public and no
RLS bypass, while every DDL statement it attempts is refused.
DEPLOYMENT: NOT done, and this is why the blocker stays open. Production still connects with
a single superuser DATABASE_URL. Closing it needs, on the Railway Postgres:
1. CREATE ROLE playbookos_app LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS;
2. GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public; GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON ALL TABLES;
GRANT USAGE,SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES; (and ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES for future tables)
3. set MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL to the owner role and DATABASE_URL to playbookos_app
4. run node scripts/migrate.js BEFORE the app starts, as a deploy step
docs/deploy/prpa-cloud-handover.md carries the exact statements and the rollback.
blockers.blocks_release_because: the deployed application still connects as a superuser until the two URLs above are split; the code no longer requires it to.
